name: live-preview
description: Built-in live-reloading HTML preview (bundled — see extensions/build.mjs).

livePreview.autoRefresh.description: Automatically reload the preview when the HTML file or a sibling file in its folder changes.

livePreview.pollInterval.description: How often (ms) to check the previewed folder for changes when auto-refresh is on.

livePreview.agentPrograms.description: Comma-separated foreground commands (tmux's pane_current_command) the element picker's "send to agent" targets, e.g. "claude,codex".

livePreview.sendAutoSubmit.description: Submit a picked element's context to the agent immediately. Off (default) types it into the pane for you to review before pressing Enter.
